Acme annual report

Acme makes widgets for factories across the country. This report covers the full year of sales, hiring, and new plant openings, and explains where the money went and why.

Sales grew in every region this year. The north region led the way with a new plant that opened in the spring and reached full output by the fall, ahead of the plan the board set.

Hiring kept pace with sales. The company added staff in sales, support, and the plants, and it trained every new hire on the safety rules before their first shift on the floor.

Next year the company plans two more plants and a new widget line for small shops, paid for out of this year's profit, with no new debt and no change to the dividend.
